g.text: TMR=GND: timers off for slow solar charge. RISET 1.78k: 500 mA. ITERM open: 10 %.

g.desc: TMR=GND: timers off for slow solar charge. RISET 1.78k: 500 mA. ITERM open: 10 %.

g.text: EN2=L, EN1=H: USB500, 475 mA limit, VIN-DPM 4.5 V (solar-friendly).

g.desc: EN2=L, EN1=H: USB500, 475 mA limit, VIN-DPM 4.5 V (solar-friendly).

g.text: RCFG3 16.2k: VO1 = 3.3 V. RCFG1 36.5k + RCFG2 0R: VO2 = 3.3 V, no input limit. SEL = L.

g.desc: RCFG3 16.2k: VO1 = 3.3 V. RCFG1 36.5k + RCFG2 0R: VO2 = 3.3 V, no input limit. SEL = L.

g.text: BQ24074 drains 4.3 µA from BAT with no sun (largest sleep load).

g.desc: BQ24074 drains 4.3 µA from BAT with no sun (largest sleep load).

g.text: Rev B: high-side switch. Rev A switched the low side, so VBAT leaked into the ADC clamp (+27 µA at 4.05 V).

g.desc: Rev B: high-side switch. Rev A switched the low side, so VBAT leaked into the ADC clamp (+27 µA at 4.05 V).

g.text: TS: 10k NTC, ITS 75 µA. Charging only 0 to 50 °C.

g.desc: Divider 1:2, settle 5 τ = 2.5 ms. Solar divider 1M/330k: ratio 0.248.
